description: This is a FastAPI router module defining API endpoints for managing customer payment reminders, including listing, creating (sending), and retrieving reminder details. It interacts with database models for Reminders, Invoices, and Customers, and integrates with email and WhatsApp notification mechanisms.

classes.name: models.ReminderOut
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the reminder output format including status, invoice info, and contact details.

classes.name: models.ReminderCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the data needed to create/send a reminder, including invoice_id and channel.

classes.name: models.ReminderStatusEnum
classes.description: Enum representing the status of a reminder, such as 'sent' or 'failed'.

classes.name: models.Reminder
classes.description: Database ORM model for reminders, including fields like id, invoice_id, channel, status, sent_on.

classes.name: models.Invoice
classes.description: Database ORM model representing invoices, with fields such as id, invoice_number, total_amount, due_date, customer_id.

classes.name: models.Customer
classes.description: Database ORM model representing customers, including id, name, email, phone.

methods.name: list_reminders( invoice_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by invoice ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to list reminders, optionally filtered by invoice ID.

methods.name: send_reminder( reminder: models.ReminderCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint that triggers sending a reminder via email or WhatsApp and records its status in the database.

methods.name: get_reminder( reminder_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific reminder by its ID.

ctags.name: list_reminders
ctags.signature: ( invoice_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by invoice ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
